brief.title: Ashfall Verge
brief.premise: Two generations after the sky burned, a water-diviner leads a caravan across the Verge, a belt of ash-dunes where a cult is hoarding the last working wells.
constraints: No functioning electronics: all machinery is mechanical.

world.name: The Ashfall Verge
world.description: The Ashfall Verge is a belt of ash-dunes and slag walls two generations after the sky burned, where water is the only real power.

locations.name: Cinder Well
locations.description: The deepest surviving well, ringed by a wall of fused slag.

locations.name: The Ash Dunes
locations.description: A shifting belt of grey dunes where wind erases tracks within hours.

locations.name: Rust Depot
locations.description: A salvage yard of hand-cranked machines and rusted rail wagons.

locations.name: Glass Ridge
locations.description: A ridge of fused sand that shelters a caravan stop with a rain-catching cistern.

factions.name: Well Keepers
factions.description: A cult that rations water from Cinder Well and preaches that the sky punished the wasteful.

factions.name: Dune Runners
factions.description: Caravaners who guide travellers across the Ash Dunes by reading the wind.

factions.name: Depot Menders
factions.description: Mechanics who restore hand-cranked machines for trade.

rules.statement: No electronic device works anymore; every working machine is mechanical or hand-cranked.
Wind erases tracks within hours, so travel across the dunes needs a diviner's or a runner's guidance.
Anyone drawing from Cinder Well must leave a tithe of grain or labour.
Rain falls only a few times a year and only on Glass Ridge.

history.name: The Burning Sky
history.description: The sky burned for a season, scorching the land and killing the old cities.

history.name: Walling of Cinder Well
history.description: Survivors fused a slag wall around the Cinder Well to protect it from raiders.

history.name: Founding of Rust Depot
history.description: Menders gathered wrecked rail wagons and rebuilt them as hand-cranked haulers.

history.name: Rise of the Well Keepers
history.description: The Well Keepers began charging tithes at Cinder Well, claiming the sky's judgement.

conflicts.name: The Water Tithe
conflicts.description: The Dune Runners resent the Well Keepers' growing tithes at Cinder Well.

conflicts.name: The Haulage Rights
conflicts.description: The Depot Menders and the Dune Runners disagree over who may use the rebuilt wagons on the dunes.

characters.name: Sela Okonjo
characters.description: A water-diviner who serves the Well Keepers as a tithe-collector at Cinder Well.
characters.motivation: To get her caravan to Cinder Well with enough water to survive the crossing.
characters.goal: Negotiate passage and a fair tithe at Cinder Well.
characters.internal_conflict: She distrusts the Well Keepers but needs their well.
characters.external_conflict: The Well Keepers raise the tithe each season.

abilities.name: Water-divining
abilities.description: Reads wind, soil and plant stress to judge where water lies.

characters.arc: Sela learns to bargain with the cult rather than flee it.

characters.name: Brother Vane
characters.description: An elder of the Well Keepers who rations Cinder Well's water and preaches that the sky punished the wasteful.
characters.motivation: To keep the well from being drained by outsiders.
characters.goal: Make every caravan pay the full tithe.
characters.internal_conflict: He half-suspects the doctrine is a convenient story.
characters.external_conflict: The Dune Runners resent his tithes.

abilities.name: Tithe-reckoning
abilities.description: Judges at a glance what grain or labour each traveller can afford to pay.

characters.arc: Vane learns that a well guarded by fear soon has no one left to guard it for.

characters.name: Pip Tarn
characters.description: A young mechanic at Rust Depot who rebuilds hand-cranked haulers from salvaged rail wagons.
characters.motivation: To prove the Depot can build haulers that cross the dunes.
characters.goal: Finish a hand-cranked hauler that can carry a caravan's water.
characters.internal_conflict: He wants the Runners' trust but covets their wagons.
characters.external_conflict: The Runners dispute the Menders' claim to the wagons.

abilities.name: Crank-mechanics
abilities.description: Rebuilds hand-cranked haulers from salvaged rail wagons.

characters.arc: Pip learns to share the haulers.

relationships.description: Sela must pay Vane's tithe to draw water.
Pip is building a hauler for Sela's caravan.

evidence_quotes: serves the Well Keepers as a tithe-collector
labels.rationale: The description contradicts the character's own faction.
labels.correction_hint: Rewrite Sela's description as a Dune Runner diviner.

evidence_summary: Sela's description says she serves the Well Keepers as a tithe-collector, but her faction is the Dune Runners and her home is Glass Ridge.
